name: Push Button

emergencyStop.label: Emergency stop (mushroom head)
emergencyStop.desc: A red mushroom head on a yellow station that latches when struck and stays in until it is used again, like twisting a real E-stop out. Its contact is always normally closed, so the tag reads true while the stop is released and false while it is in.

text.label: Face label
text.desc: The legend plate above the button, the way a lamacoid is mounted. Keep it short enough to read at station distance.

buttonColor.label: Button color
buttonColor.desc: Tint of the cap, and of the lamp when it lights.

momentary.label: Momentary (else maintained latch)
momentary.desc: On, each press is a fixed 0.3 s pulse of sim time, like a spring-return start button - so a paused sim holds the pulse rather than letting it expire. Off, the button latches on one press and releases on the next, like a maintained selector.

startPressed.label: Starts pressed (maintained only)
startPressed.desc: A maintained button starts latched in, so a run begins with it pressed. A momentary button springs back on its own, so it ignores this.

startStruck.label: Starts struck
startStruck.desc: The emergency stop starts latched in, so a run begins with the stop open - the way to check that a line refuses to start until it is twisted out.

normallyClosed.label: Normally closed (inverts the signal)
normallyClosed.desc: Invert the output, so the tag reads true while the button is NOT pressed - the safety convention for a stop button, where a broken wire reads the same as a press.

lampSource.label: Lamp source
lampSource.desc: What lights the cap. Follows press echoes this button, the way a contact strapped to the light block would. PLC tag hands the lamp to the program through Lamp tag below - the acknowledge wiring a real panel uses. Always on is a power-on indicator. Unlit is a button with no light block fitted.

enableComms.label: Enable comms
enableComms.desc: Connect this part to a PLC program. Its tags appear once this is on.

tag.label: Button output tag
tag.desc: Where the button publishes its press for the program to read. Whether true means pressed or at-rest is set by Normally closed above.

lampTag.label: Lamp tag (PLC lights the cap)
lampTag.desc: Which PLC bool lights the cap, so the program can acknowledge a press rather than just echo it. Read only when Lamp source above is set to PLC tag; left unbound there, the lamp stays dark like an unwired light block.
